description: Downloads predicted protein structures from the EBI AlphaFold Database API and exports per-protein prediction metadata. Resolves the current PDB/CIF download URL from the API instead of hard-coding a model version, supports batch accession lists, resumable downloads, pLDDT-based quality filtering before spending bandwidth, and validates response content types so HTML error pages are never mistaken for structure files. This skill should be used when fetching AlphaFold models, retrieving predicted structures by UniProt accession, or collecting AlphaFold confidence metrics (pLDDT) is requested.
